description: TractorData.com is a web reference of specifications for 18,317 farm, lawn and industrial tractors, organised by make, such as Allis-Chalmers, Case IH, John Deere, Kubota, Massey Ferguson and New Holland, with a comparison tool and news of new models. It is run by a family-owned small business in southern Minnesota and has provided specifications to farmers, homeowners and the machinery industry for 25 years. Coverage is global makes with a North American emphasis, from historical models to announcements for 2027. The pages are available free online; no licence is stated. Caveats: data are compiled by the site owner from manufacturer and other sources without stated methods, and no download or API was seen on the page read. For simulation it provides engine power, weights and other attributes of farm machinery for models of farm operations, fuel demand and the capacity of agricultural fleets to work fields after disasters. It is related to the Tractor-Info record in this catalogue, a similar database.
